results.question: 2026年上海各月实收租金是多少？按月份升序。
results.generated_sql: SELECT rp.billing_month, SUM(rp.amount_paid) AS total_rent_collected FROM rent_payments rp JOIN leases l ON rp.lease_id = l.lease_id JOIN units u ON l.unit_id = u.unit_id JOIN properties p ON u.property_id = p.property_id WHERE p.city = '上海' AND rp.billing_month >= '2026-01' AND rp.billing_month <= '2026-12' GROUP BY rp.billing_month ORDER BY rp.billing_month ASC;
results.summary: 统计2026年上海各项目按账期归属的每月实收租金总额，并按月份升序排列。

results.question: 2026年8月每个项目的租金收缴率是多少？从高到低。
results.generated_sql:
WITH billing_data AS (
    SELECT
        p.property_id,
        p.property_name,
        rp.billing_month,
        SUM(rp.amount_paid) AS total_paid,
        SUM(rp.amount_due) AS total_due
    FROM rent_payments rp
    JOIN leases l ON rp.lease_id = l.lease_id
    JOIN units u ON l.unit_id = u.unit_id
    JOIN properties p ON u.property_id = p.property_id
    WHERE rp.billing_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY p.property_id, p.property_name, rp.billing_month
)
SELECT
    property_name,
    CASE
        WHEN total_due > 0 THEN ROUND(total_paid * 1.0 / total_due, 4)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS collection_rate
FROM billing_data
ORDER BY collection_rate DESC;
results.summary: 统计2026年8月账期各项目的租金收缴率（实收/应收），按比率从高到低排序。
disclosures: 租金收缴率按账期统计，等于同一账期实收租金除以应收租金，不按到账日混入往期回款。
